name: Ophthalmology
boundaries: Ophthalmology: fundamental discoveries and enabling technologies within this field. Include cross-field consequences where the central advance belongs to this field; exclude routine incremental optimization. Use the historical breakthroughs in the prompt to calibrate revolutionary impact.

original_dispositions.original_title: Complete regeneration of the adult retina and optic nerve
original_dispositions.reason: Covered, split on purpose. Optic-nerve reconnection is OPH-01. Photoreceptor, RPE, and choroidal reconstruction is OPH-02. Merging them would hide two different barriers. The historical impact sentence, which also folds in glaucoma and inherited dystrophy as one cure, overreaches either entry alone.

original_dispositions.original_title: Permanent one-time cure for open-angle and angle-closure glaucoma, including RGC protection and restored outflow
original_dispositions.reason: Covered in part. RGC protection when pressure is not the lever is OPH-10. Regrowth of lost axons is OPH-01. A new outflow drug or operation was not added. Drops, laser, and surgery already lower pressure. Angle closure is treated by iridotomy and lens extraction. Convenience and durability of outflow treatment are incremental.

original_dispositions.original_title: Noninvasive cellular-resolution retinal imaging without adaptive optics
original_dispositions.reason: The principle is already demonstrated, and the “without adaptive optics” constraint is not the scientific gap. NEI’s retina program asks to “translate high-resolution retinal imaging technologies, like adaptive optics, into cost-effective and easy-to-use platforms for routine clinical use” (https://www.nei.nih.gov/grants-and-funding/research-priorities/retina, page updated 13 February 2026). A commercial adaptive-optics fundus camera, the rtx1, already images cone mosaics in clinical studies. Adaptive-optics OCT that resolves ganglion-cell somas exists in research: one 2024 system was built because “clinicians are unable to detect glaucoma until substantial loss” of those cells, and it visualized ganglion-cell-layer somas in the living human eye (Biomedical Optics Express, 31 January 2024, https://doi.org/10.1364/BOE.505395, abstract). A 2026 review states that “AOOCT systems are currently restricted to research settings, with no commercial device with regulatory approval available at present” (https://doi.org/10.1080/17469899.2026.2645147, “Current commercial systems”; author list not extracted). Wider, cheaper, routine use would be valuable. It is deployment of an achieved imaging principle, not a new one. The NEI 2021 plan’s prediction of cellular functional imaging is a tool for the regenerative entries, not a separate revolution.

original_dispositions.original_title: Universal durable gene therapy for all inherited retinal dystrophies
original_dispositions.reason: Covered by OPH-07 for eyes that still have the target cells. Cure after those cells are gone is OPH-02. “No immune response” and “any stage” were not split into new IDs.

original_dispositions.original_title: Pharmacological prevention that completely halts myopia progression
original_dispositions.reason: Covered by OPH-06. The historical item is one route to a growth set point. Existing atropine, lenslets, orthokeratology, and red light slow growth and do not meet OPH-06.

original_dispositions.original_title: Bioengineered, patient-specific, innervated cornea with lifelong transparency
original_dispositions.reason: Covered by OPH-04. Autologous matching and reinnervation are routes and components. The revolutionary scope remains a clear cornea for vascularized stromal blindness without a human donor cornea. Endothelial cell therapy and keratoconus inlays stay excluded as already partly achieved.

original_dispositions.original_title: Real-time molecular-guided intraoperative imaging and ablation for ocular tumors
original_dispositions.reason: Retinoblastoma and uveal melanoma already have established local treatments, including chemotherapy, radiation, and excision or enucleation. Live molecular margins and non-thermal ablation would be a finer surgical tool. Metastatic uveal melanoma is a systemic cancer problem. An ocular imaging aid does not meet the calibration bar for a field-level change.

original_dispositions.original_title: A single posterior-segment depot lasting two to five years
original_dispositions.reason: Sustained anti-VEGF delivery is already a product class. Susvimo, a surgically implanted port for ranibizumab, was FDA-approved for neovascular AMD in 2021, with refills about every 24 weeks, and later for diabetic macular edema and diabetic retinopathy (Genentech, 4 February 2025, https://www.gene.com/media/press-releases/15050/2025-02-04/fda-approves-genentechs-susvimo-as-the-f; DailyMed medication guide, revised May 2025, https://dailymed.nlm.nih.gov/dailymed/medguide.cfm?setid=9c6d9e2a-9a77-4d11-b692-de87cfde3444). A two-to-five-year interval would be longer durability of the same idea. It does not create a new biological capability. Reperfusion of dead capillaries remains OPH-08.

original_dispositions.original_title: A molecular cure for severe dry eye and ocular-surface disease
original_dispositions.reason: Symptom-directed therapies are already in clinical use. A root-cause restoration of lacrimal glands and goblet cells would matter, especially in severe ocular-surface failure, but the historical write-up treats a very common discomfort syndrome as if it were a new principle of sight. Blinding corneal consequences of surface failure sit inside OPH-04. No separate dry-eye concept cleared the bar.

original_dispositions.original_title: A high-resolution prosthesis with acuity near 20/40, full field, and color
original_dispositions.reason: Covered only for the case with no usable eye-to-brain pathway, which is OPH-05. That entry does not adopt 20/40 as a required threshold. For retinitis pigmentosa or AMD with surviving inner retina, PRIMA has already shown prosthetic form vision, and pushing pixels, field, and color is incremental engineering. It was not given a new ID.

reconciliation_change_log.change: OPH-01 through OPH-10 are kept under the same IDs and the same capabilities. None was replaced or merged.

OPH-01 now states its boundary with OPH-02 and OPH-10, and adds the NEI Audacious Goals Initiative as evidence that regeneration is an official target and not an achieved therapy. The “half the acuity” sentence from Lu et al. is marked as a first-pass PDF extract, not re-verified in publisher HTML.

OPH-02 now uses the 2013 NEI statement that advanced AMD is the leading cause of blindness in the United States, instead of an unsourced “commonest in rich countries” phrase, and points prevention to OPH-11 and gene repair to OPH-07.

OPH-04 corrects the corneal-blindness count. The first-pass “about 2.1 million” figure is withdrawn as not re-verified. The entry now uses Wang et al., Ophthalmology, 2023, https://doi.org/10.1016/j.ophtha.2023.03.012: about 5.5 million people bilaterally blind or with moderate to severe impairment from corneal opacity, plus 6.2 million unilaterally blind. Reinnervation is stated as part of integration, so a separate “innervated autologous cornea” item is not opened.
OPH-05 now says explicitly that a 20/40, full-field, color retinal prosthesis in an eye with surviving inner retina is incremental on PRIMA, not a new concept.
OPH-06 now says a drug that truly halts axial growth is one route to the same set-point capability. Partial myopia drugs stay outside the claim.

OPH-07 drops the unsourced “about 4.7 kb” AAV figure. Vector limits are attributed only to the 2025 review. The entry now refuses the historical “cure at any stage” wording, which belongs to OPH-02 once cells are gone. The NEI 2021 bold prediction on cell-type gene control is added as a prediction, not a result.
OPH-08 now distinguishes reperfusion from longer-acting anti-VEGF delivery.
OPH-10 now states that a permanent outflow operation is not this concept, because pressure-lowering treatment already exists. The unsolved piece remains neuron death despite pressure control.
OPH-11 is new. It is prevention of late AMD while photoreceptors and RPE remain. It was not on the historical list as a separate item.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: It was added because AREDS leaves most intermediate-AMD risk intact, and because restoration after cell death (OPH-02) does not cover that population.
